The perforated-strip cue borrows from the universal cinema tradition and the modern indie-film aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as cinema-life rather than literal film reel.

In real-world usage 🎞 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate cinema-coded energy. A friend sends it on a 'vintage-film hype 🎞' reveal. The strip-of-frames cue is what makes the emoji feel cinema-coded — it is not just 'film strip,' it is 'cinema-coded nostalgia flex.'

What separates 🎞 from the rest of the cinema-emoji family is the cinema-life register. The emoji is not saying 'movie camera' (🎥), 'film projector' (📽), or 'clapperboard' (🎬).
